notes.title: BONETOWN IS COMING TO STEAM THIS SUMMER
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35001913/a037a2428a984312be09ae7e65eae7d86f29e620.jpg

You heard right! The other game from the makers of BoneCraft, the world’s first Action Adventure Porno video game, BoneTown, is coming to Steam. If you know BoneTown, you might be thinking that this must mean a dumbed-down, censored, M-rated version with no sex. But BoneTown wouldn’t be BoneTown if you couldn’t bang any girl in the game, any time. With Steam’s updated rules now allowing adult content, BoneTown players old and new can now experience the entire game on Steam, in its full adult XXX glory. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35001913/91492e675571580404a8a1148463e1f76c78372c.jpg

For us developers, this re-release has given us another crack at the game many of you have played and loved for years now--and yeah, we went a little overboard. So much so that we decided this isn’t the same BoneTown anymore. The Steam version will be a new edition of the game: BoneTown: The Second Coming Edition. What does that entail? Well, we’ll tell you all about it soon on the BoneTown Steam page. Over the next couple months until release, we will be talking a lot here on Steam about what you can expect in the new edition, and what the future holds for BoneTown, including contests, giveaways, and more. 

So put BoneTown on your Wishlist today and don’t miss an update--and we’ll see you this summer, when BoneTown welcomes you to its shores once again.

The sexiest Princess in the galaxy is coming to BoneCraft. On August 8th, D-Dub will release The Race to AmadollaHo DLC, which will add a new competition to BoneCraft. 

Can you save AmadollaHo from the robots that are keeping her prisoner? You'd better pack all the Jet Fuel you can chug, because this platform jumping competition is going to involve a lot of drinking. But when the reward is sex with a Princess, who wouldn't give it all they've got?

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions about BoneCraft
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35001913/ff26d0a8a3d867ff2e1cf7b7820673e7e863ef6d.jpg

[olist]
What is BoneCraft?

BoneCraft is an adult action adventure RPG comedy video game. It is a single player game, and if you like fucking, fighting or Sci-Fi / Fantasy, then you will like BoneCraft.

What is BoneCraft rated?

BoneCraft is not rated by the ESRB. If it were to be rated by the ESRB it would surely receive an Adults Only (AO) rating–and this is why you must be 18 or older to purchase and play it. 

Can I have sex in BoneCraft?

Yes. In BoneCraft, every girl you see is fair game to try and have sex with. Not all of them will say ‘yes,’ and the elves might even try to attack you instead, but as in real life: no risk, no reward.

What kind of sex can I have in BoneCraft?

We’ve tried to include as much as we can, so here is the Naughty List: BJ, Anal, Cowgirl, Doggy, Froggy, Standing, Against a Wall, Hair Pulling, Spanking, Salad Tossing, Sitting, Ass to Mouth, Threesome, Girl on Girl, Orgy, and Tranny. This coupled with the thousands of unique girls of all races and species, and you have a lot of fetish stuff to do in BoneCraft--if you’re one of those guys who has to try it all.

Are there human girls in BoneCraft?

Yes. While the gameplay only includes orc and elf girls, the Sex Stores available at the start of each mission give you access to human girls. This includes blondes, redheads, Black girls, Asian girls, Native American girls, Indian girls, Hispanic girls, teens, and a whole slew of random girls. 

Is BoneCraft just a Sex Simulator?

We have sex, but we are so much more. BoneCraft is a true video game, meaning we have gameplay, story, strategy, missions, unlockables, upgradables and everything else you would expect from a video game, while also having a full sex dynamic built into it. It’s hard to believe because it’s never happened before, but believe it.

What is different between BoneCraft and BoneTown?

Both games have sex, fighting and drug use. BoneCraft is a Sci-Fi / Fantasy parody, while BoneTown is a Grand Theft Auto / South Park parody. BoneCraft is a linear storyline in a smaller world, while BoneTown is a choose your own adventure in a large open world. 

Will BoneTown come to Steam?

Yes. We are doing some improvements on BoneTown’s graphics and gameplay, and then we will release it. Look for it later in 2019, and keep checking Steam for more release information.
[/olist]

notes.title: Information about BoneCraft’s Release
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35001913/88d5a01c17857558af6e735b52090ebeab2cf98e.jpg

We are less than 2 weeks away from BoneCraft’s release on Steam! 

When we released the naughtiest Sci-Fi / Fantasy game ever created, we thought there’d be no way Steam would ever allow it, but here we are. The world has changed, for the better, and adult gamers are finally getting the adult games they deserve. BoneCraft is a game where any concerns for a M Rating were thrown out the door on the first day of development. So BoneCraft is totally not for children, but if you are an adult, I guarantee you’ve never played a game like this before. 

Some of you might have already played BoneCraft and are wondering what is different about the Steam version. For the Steam release, we have gone back over the graphics and gameplay, making improvements to bring it up to speed. We have also added Steam Stats and Achievements, so now you can not only put numbers to your conquests, but also unlock the most outrageous Steam Achievements you’ve ever seen, like Once You Go Green, or The Glory Hole. We have also integrated our three release girls (C3P-Ho, Robo-Ho, and Princess AmadollaHo) into the game, so everyone can experience them.    

You will be hearing more from us soon, as we build to the release of the most AO video game ever slung on the pages of Steam. So . . . if you’re interested in those sort of things, add BoneCraft to your Wishlist and make sure to not miss a thing.
